mintAuthority.summary: wM is a pure M-backed wrapper: Ethereum wrap/unwrap transfers M before minting or burns wM before returning M, while the Solana m_ext path mints Token-2022 wM only after M is deposited into its extension vault. Wrapper-local logic remains mutable: Ethereum migration requires a TTG-registered migrator and the current one-of-two migrationAdmin Safe, while the Solana m_ext ProgramData is upgradeable by a bare EOA. Base M issuance is inherited from reviewed m-m0 and is not a second direct wM controller.

controls.label: WrappedMToken EIP-1967 proxy (Migratable)
controls.capDescription: EIP-1967 minimal proxy with no admin slot; current implementation 0x6d9d63afccf515f393d5e65be69d38bb3b29d13 keeps wrap/unwrap M-backed, but upgrade requires a TTG-registered migrator AND migrationAdmin 0xf7298f047f92d0eb21231478ef6ba9fe1ecd4c73 to call migrate(). The migration Safe is one-of-two, so replacement logic can change the wrapper-local economic bound.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25773353, the EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0x6d9d63afccf515f393d5e65be69d38bb3b29d13 and the admin slot was zero. migrationAdmin() returned 0xf7298f047f92d0eb21231478ef6ba9fe1ecd4c73; that Safe returned two owners, threshold 1, Safe version 1.4.1, and no enabled modules. Guard and fallback-handler reads reverted and are not treated as verified controls. The current WrappedMToken implementation transfers M before minting wM and burns wM before returning M; migration additionally requires the TTG Registrar migrator key.

controls.label: Solana wM m_ext wrapper mint authority PDA
controls.capDescription: The m_ext program's mint-authority PDA Anfx7wng5TEe5UrkFKTirtADBawmtRs9KoD15BUbEmv mints Token-2022 wM only after the wrap instruction transfers canonical M into the extension vault. This is wrapper-local issuance, not native M issuance; the current bound can be replaced by the program upgrade authority.
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 439806760, the Token-2022 mint mzeroXDoBpRVhnEXBra27qzAMdxgpWVY3DzQW7xMVJp had mint authority PDA Anfx7wng5TEe5UrkFKTirtADBawmtRs9KoD15BUbEmv and freeze authority 9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW. Official m_ext wrap.rs transfers M into the extension vault before invoking Token-2022 mintTo, so the PDA is currently M-backed and cap-limited; the upgradeable m_ext ProgramData names the same EOA as upgrade authority.

controls.label: Solana wM m_ext ProgramData upgrade authority
bypassSurfaces: The m_ext upgrade authority can replace the wrapper program and remove or relax the observed M-vault-before-mint invariant without an independent delay.
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 439806760, m_ext ProgramData BZzPduAchLyMwRZXgYcXnqvDmecBuWroEjgRSSHj9uSF named 9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW as upgrade authority. This EOA can replace the local wrapper logic and therefore can change the current deposit-before-mint bound; it is modeled as wrapper-local authority, not as an issuer of native M.

review.evidence: Boundary review at Ethereum block 25773353 and finalized Solana slot 439806760: Ethereum wM remains a 1:1 M-backed wrapper with a current one-of-two migrationAdmin Safe and TTG-registered migrator gate; Solana m_ext likewise transfers canonical M into its extension vault before minting Token-2022 wM, but its ProgramData is upgradeable by 9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW. The inherited Ethereum MinterGateway is reviewed under m-m0 and is not duplicated as a direct wm-m0 control. Continuous M/wM reconciliation and M0 Validator attestations remain relevant, but wrapper code replacement makes the economic cap unbounded and there is no prudential supervisor.
